critical_code_review_comments: CommandPalette.jsx (335 LOC) is clean, self-contained, single-source-of-truth for DESTINATIONS and ACTIONS — easy to extend.

runAction correctly: (a) guards on missing iid with toast.error, (b) sets busy state for the disabled+'running…' affordance, (c) catches errors and surfaces formatApiError(err.response.data.detail) | label-fallback, (d) only navigates on success, (e) always clears busy in finally — race-free.
Action item value strings include keywords (e.g. 'naac aqar compass accreditation') so cmdk fuzzy search hits across synonyms. Verified: typing 'kpi' filters to kpi-stream only.
Recent push happens for BOTH plain destinations (go) AND action navigations (runAction.out.path) — consistent UX.
The 'running…' affordance was visible for ~15s while Claude generated the SSR section before the success toast resolved. Good UX.

Minor nit (carry-over from Phase-28, not a regression): data-testid for destinations is still `cmdk-item${path.replace(/\//g,'-')}` producing `cmdk-item-` for '/' and double dashes for recent IDs — selectors with [^=] still match, but cleaner concatenation (e.g. cmdk-item-dashboard) would aid readability. Phase-29 testids `cmdk-action-<id>` are clean and consistent.

Backend endpoints exercised by the 10 actions all returned 200 (observed via network panel): /api/nexus2/{iid}/fees/predict-defaulters, /api/closeout/{iid}/command/kpi-stream, /api/closeout/{iid}/compass/ssr-compose, /api/closeout/{iid}/greeniq/esg-composite, /api/closeout/{iid}/greeniq/carbon-footprint, /api/nexus2/{iid}/attendance/auto-alert, /api/veda/{iid}/kb/ingest-run, /api/veda/{iid}/kb/status, /api/closeout/{iid}/guardian/incident-dashboard, /api/closeout/{iid}/compass/accreditation-timeline.

success_rate.backend: N/A (skipped per request — but all 10 underlying endpoints returned 200 via the UI)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase-29 ACTIONS in CommandPalette.jsx fully working. To replay: login → click [data-testid='cmdk-trigger'] (FAB, md+) or press Ctrl+K → click any cmdk-action-<id>. Toast and navigation behavior verified for all 10. generate-aqar takes ~15s (LLM) and correctly shows 'running…' suffix while pending. Recent group surfaces last navigation (incl. action-driven nav) on reopen. To capture toasts robustly when actions also navigate the page, install a MutationObserver before clicking — sonner toasts persist across route changes but the original DOM node may be detached during navigation snapshotting.
